scope: Qualified reader disclosure only; not source selection or main-English revision

sources.limit: Unmarked resh is not proof of physical certainty; Fox disputes the decisive letter.

sources.title: Michael V. Fox, Proverbs: An Eclectic Edition with Introduction and Textual Commentary (2015)
sources.locator: printed p.229 / PDF p.251; complete page rendered and inspected
sources.limit: Greek and Syriac support is reported by the edition, not independently collated versional manuscripts.

approved_append: A published Qumran transcription reads a different word related to “lack,” but the decisive letter is disputed. Greek and Syriac readings have also been interpreted this way. POB provisionally retains the Masoretic wording.

review.verdict: Scoped PASS for the proposed disclosure and preservation plan.
review.correction: After inspecting Fox p.229, the agent withdrew its initial impression that the QDR unmarked resh was physically secure: resh is damaged and dalet is possible.
review.approved_scope: Retain all three candidate source/main-English texts; append exact qualified 14:34 disclosure; archive existing cross_check, revision_pass and source_audit verbatim; mark the edited record draft/needs_review.
review.limits: Proposal review, not approval of the unapplied diff, blind transcription, different-family benchmark, earliest-source priority, whole-verse translation or independent historical corroboration. Root separately verified application.

verification.exact_expected_parsed_record: PASS; deep-copied baseline plus only the enumerated changes equals the full applied record
verification.reader_footnote_tests: PASS; 8 tests via existing .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_reader_footnote_export.py

full_proverbs_export.serialization: UTF-8 json.dumps with ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')
full_proverbs_export.method: Existing tools.export_mobile_bible.export_book('PRO'); baseline substitutes only the pinned old 14:34 record through load_translation_record.

verification.limits: Checks establish bounded application/export behavior, not earliest wording, full-corpus translation quality or public deployment.

reopen_when: Decisive glyph/edition evidence or a discriminating versional transmission argument changes the evidential balance; no repeat judge-until-agreement loop.
